# Language-Specific Instructions

This directory contains instruction files for **retort**, one per
rule domain defined in `.agentkit/spec/rules.yaml`. Each file provides
language-specific coding conventions, testing patterns, and tooling requirements.

These files are generated by Retort and deployed to each configured AI
platform:

| Platform             | Output location                   |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| GitHub Copilot       | `.github/instructions/languages/` |
| Claude / Claude Code | `.claude/rules/languages/`        |
| Cursor               | `.cursor/rules/languages/`        |
| Cline                | `.clinerules/languages/`          |
| Roo                  | `.roo/rules/languages/`           |
| Windsurf             | `.windsurf/rules/languages/`      |

## Active Languages

| File | Language | Applies to | Globs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## How It Works

For each rule domain, Retort renders a Markdown file using the
following template priority:

1. **Platform overlay** — `<platform>/language-instructions/<domain>.md`
   (platform-specific customisation)
2. **Shared template** — `language-instructions/<domain>.md`
   (language-specific content shared across all platforms)
3. **Generic fallback** — `language-instructions/TEMPLATE.md`
   (used when no domain-specific template exists)

All templates receive both project-level variables and per-rule variables
(`ruleConventions`, `ruleDomain`, etc.) from `rules.yaml`, so conventions
defined in the YAML flow automatically into the generated docs.

## Adding a New Language

1. Add a new rule domain to `.agentkit/spec/rules.yaml`.
2. Create a template at `.agentkit/templates/language-instructions/<domain>.md`.
3. Optionally create platform overlays in
   `.agentkit/templates/<platform>/language-instructions/<domain>.md`.

## Generated From

- **Project config**: `stack.languages` in `.agentkit/spec/project.yaml`
- **Rule specs**: per-domain entries in `.agentkit/spec/rules.yaml`
- **Shared templates**: `.agentkit/templates/language-instructions/`
- **Platform overlays**: `.agentkit/templates/<platform>/language-instructions/`
